question.text: Which of the following screens would a value-style portfolio manager most likely use to identify candidate stocks?

answer.text: Low P/E, low PEG, low P/B, low Debt-to-Equity
High forecast EPS growth, high RoE

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Value screens target mispricing by filtering on low relative-valuation multiples and conservative leverage. **The Trap:** High forecast EPS growth and high RoE are growth screens; momentum/short-interest are price-action signals. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same screens in XV Ch 10 (Valuation) and X-A Ch 4. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Pure value screens can drag in 'value traps' — companies cheap for good reason. Combining with quality (RoCE, low debt) filters most traps.
